# Project Context

## Repository intent

- **repo_intent.summary:** Demo mobile banking app (BrowserStack Bank) — Expo/React Native frontend + Express.js backend. Features: login, OTP 2FA, biometric auth, liveness/KYC, Stripe payments, transfers, cards, transactions, shop, admin controls. Built as a BrowserStack demo app for mobile testing.

## Language & package manager

- **language.package_manager:** npm
- **language.primary:** TypeScript
- **language.secondary:** JavaScript

## Test framework

- **framework.mobile:** Expo 54 with expo-router (file-based routing), React Native 0.81.5
- **framework.backend:** Express.js 4 with Neon serverless PostgreSQL (@neondatabase/serverless)

## Code conventions

- **conventions.routing:** Expo Router file-based routing — app/ directory with route groups: (banking) for authenticated user screens, (admin) for admin screens, (tabs) for tab navigation
- **conventions.state_management:** Module-level singleton stores (AuthStore in store/auth.ts, api in store/api.ts, banking store in store/banking.ts) — no Redux/Zustand
- **conventdddddddddddddddions.api_client:** Centralized api object in store/api.ts; all calls go through request() helper with Bearer token auth header
- **conventions.token_storage:** JWT stored in AsyncStorage under key auth_token; in-memory cache (_memToken) for sync access
- **conventions.styling:** StyleSheet.create() per file; theme constants in constants/theme.ts (BSColors palette)
- **conventions.test_ids:** testID props used on key UI elements for automation (e.g. testID=email-input, testID=bs-logo, testID=password-input)

## Environment & configuration

- **env.server:** DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, JWT_EXPIRES_IN (optional, default 7d), STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, PORT (optional, default 3000). Loaded from .env at repo root via dotenv (path '../.env' from server/).
- **env.mobile:** EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PK (Stripe publishable key, set per EAS build profile in eas.json)

## Application auth

- **auth_pattern.type:** JWT + OTP two-factor authentication
- **auth_pattern.demo_credentials_pattern:** Demo autofill buttons exist on login screen (app/index.tsx) for regular user and wrong-password scenarios. OTP screen shows server OTP as a hint in demo mode; static fallback OTP also available. See app/index.tsx autoFillRegular() for credential pattern.
- **auth_pattern.admin_role:** Same login flow as regular user; role field in JWT payload determines routing to admin screens under app/(admin)/
- **auth_pattern.login_flow:** POST /auth/login → JWT token → stored in AsyncStorage (key: auth_token) + in-memory. Redirect to /otp → POST /auth/send-otp → 6-digit OTP (shown as hint in demo). POST /auth/verify-otp → routes to /(banking)/home. Signup: POST /auth/signup → OTP → /liveness for KYC. API uses Authorization Bearer header. Server validates via authMiddleware (jsonwebtoken).
